responsibility: This header is GCC’s central host-side portability wrapper that pulls in system headers and normalizes platform/compiler differences for the compiler proper. It defines common feature macros, unlocked stdio remappings, portability typedefs and declarations, cast/debug/Valgrind helpers, qsort redirection to GCC’s deterministic sort, size-formatting macros, and small utility functions like startswith/endswith. It is the foundational convenience and compatibility layer that most GCC source files include before using host C/C++ library facilities.
